title: Proposal
description: The lanes and the routes that up proposes from a plugin's steps, which up writes to a file and passes to `lay.py print <plugin> <file>`. Each lane names its type, and lay.py makes its sentence from that type alone.

plugin.description: The plugin's name, as its plugin.json gives it.

skills.description: Each skill whose call begins a run of its own, beside the runs of the others in a conversation.

role.description: The skill's or a subagent's name.

step.description: The step's number in the role's Steps.

type.description: A lane type's name, as `lay.py types` gives it.

takes.description: What the type takes, each command or path word for word, each name in braces a run value.

skill.description: The skill whose run the route moves.

after.description: `first`, `<role> <result>`, a command the person types, such as `/changelog:pause`, or the skill `<plugin>:<skill>` of another plugin that a move called, for the moves once the main conversation goes back to its own steps.

role.description: The role that a start or a resume names, or the skill `<plugin>:<skill>` of another plugin that a call calls.

waits_for.description: The command the person types before the move is due.

text_adapter.description: The program in hooks/adapters/ that gives a start's text, where the plugin has one.

results_adapter.description: The program in hooks/adapters/ that gives the Kept results, where the plugin has one.
